inverter.title: Inverter
inverter.description: Configure PV sensor and inverter control. Skip inverter fields if you have no battery.

data.inverter_verb_self_use: Normal/self-use option string (used when EV is not charging)
data.inverter_verb_battery_control: Battery control option string (used when EV is charging)
data.active_power_entity: Inverter active power entity (W) — positive = discharge, negative = charge

ev.title: EV Charger
ev.description: Configure EV sensors. EMS writes computed watts directly to ev_charge_target_entity every second.

data.ev_target_soc: EV target SoC — number or sensor entity (%) — optional, defaults to 80 %

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Configure grid and house load sensors.

data.max_grid_import_w: Maximum grid import — number entity (W) — optional, defaults to 4500 W
